title: The App That Began as an Internal Tool
short_teaser: Many products begin as tools built to solve a company’s own recurring problem.
story: Many products begin as tools built to solve a company’s own recurring problem. When others face the same problem, the private solution can become a market offering. Internal friction may reveal an opportunity if the pattern extends beyond one organization. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections that gradually become useful. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
